hook_text: There is a line around the middle of the Earth that nobody can see. What is it?
clip_script: Polokwane. A globe spins, and a strip of red tape runs around its middle. That is the equator, an imaginary line halfway between the North Pole and the South Pole. North of it, the Northern Hemisphere. South of it, the Southern Hemisphere, where South Africa is. Seven continents: Asia is the biggest, then Africa. Five oceans: the Pacific is the biggest. And Africa sits right across the equator, in both halves of the world.
visual_style: Whiteboard globe spinning with a red line drawing around its middle, then the seven continents labelling themselves one by one.
mood: Bright and amazed, like seeing the whole world at once.
pacing: Slow spin for the poles and equator, then quick labels for continents and oceans.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and try to name all seven continents from memory.
